newsitem.title: USA: BEFORE THE BELL - MCI, British Tel ADRs rise.
newsitem.headline: BEFORE THE BELL - MCI, British Tel ADRs rise.

text.p: The merger agreement between MCI Communications Corp and British Telecommunications Plc drew investor cheers in first U.S. market activity to digest the news.
As soon at MCI stock was released from a Nasdaq trading halt in Monday's pre-open session, the shares move to 33-3/8 from 30-1/4, but then began to slip into a trading range around 32.
Meanwhile, British Telecom's NYSE-traded American Depositary Receipts were active at 61-7/8, up 6-3/8.
Conrail shares were run over by sellers eager to lock-in the steep share price that resulted after CSX Corp and Norfolk Southern Corp submitted bids for the company last month.

Traders said the prospect of a robust takeover premium has vanished after Norfolk said it is talking with CSX about each company's Conrail bid, news that led traders to believe some kind of three-way agreement will be forged, precluding a Conrail bidding war.
Conrail stock fell 8-1/4 to 87 on the news, while traders reported no early activity in CSX or Norfolk.
"Apparently, rather than have a competitive bid situation for Conrail, it is going to be divided. They may be talks to split up the assets instead of a bidding war," a trader said.
Physician Corp of America stock rose to 12 from 10-5/8 after it said it will merger with Sierra Health Services Inc.
Micron Technology Inc shares traded sharply higher ahead of the open, up 1-1/4 to 26-1/2, on the endorsement of a Merrill Lynch upgrade this morning to long-term buy from accumulate.
